verdict.rationale: Eqvista documents its own access controls: advanced permissions that decide who can view or modify equity data, custom roles (e.g., an executor role for signing certificates), and centralized stakeholder access replacing spreadsheets. In principle, these could give outside counsel a working seat in the platform. Nothing in the evidence describes law-firm or outside-counsel roles, or counsel preparing documents and updating records directly. Missing for 10: dedicated law-firm/counsel role types, documented counsel workflows for drafting documents and editing records, multi-client law-firm access, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
